cards.name: Late Arrival

text.en: Give your clue last in the first clue turn.
text.fil: Ikaw ang huling magbibigay ng clue sa unang ikot.

cards.when: Play when hearing the room first is worth more than keeping a passive.

notes.imposter: you hear every clue before yours.

cards.name: Opening Act

text.en: Give your clue first in the first clue turn.
text.fil: Ikaw ang unang magbibigay ng clue sa unang ikot.

cards.when: Lead when you can set a believable clue.

notes.decoy: your cousin-word clue sets the room's direction.

cards.name: Put on the Spot

text.en: Pick a player. They owe one more clue: their name sits at the top of the clue board until they give it.
text.fil: Pumili ng player. Utang niya ang isa pang clue. Nasa tuktok ng clue board ang pangalan niya hanggang maibigay niya ’yon.

cards.when: Pressure the quietest or shakiest player.

notes.imposter: squeeze a civilian into a clumsy clue.

cards.name: Anonymous Tip

text.en: Name a suspect. When voting opens, everyone sees 'Someone suspects Ben'. Your name stays hidden.
text.fil: Pumili ng suspek. Pagbukas ng botohan, makikita ng lahat ang “May naghihinala kay Ben.” Lihim kung sino ka.

cards.when: Point at someone without your name on it.

notes.accomplice: point the room away from your Imposter.

cards.name: On the Record

text.en: Show everyone your vote and lock it now. Get 2 points if you picked the Imposter.
text.fil: Ipakita sa lahat ang boto mo at i-lock na ito ngayon. May 2 puntos ka kung Imposter ang binoto mo.

cards.when: Commit when your read is strong and start a bandwagon.

notes.imposter: your shown vote looks real but never counts.

cards.name: Word Count

text.en: See how many letters the real word has. Only you see the number. Only the Imposter and the Decoy can play it.
text.fil: Ilang letra ang totoong salita? Ikaw lang ang makakakita ng bilang. Imposter o Decoy lang ang puwedeng gumamit nito.

cards.when: Narrow the hint, or test your Decoy word.

notes.decoy: could your word be the real one?

cards.name: Cover Story

text.en: Claim any role on everyone's screen. Results show whether it was true.
text.fil: Pumili ng role na aangkinin mo. Sa screen ng lahat lalabas ang claim mo. Sa resulta malalaman kung totoo.

cards.when: Claim a role while suspicion is moving.

notes.decoy: claim Judge or Detective to draw votes.

cards.name: Second Opinion

text.en: Name a backup suspect. If your vote is wrong and your backup is the Imposter, you score as if you were right and skip Drink/Dare. Your bet still settles as usual.
text.fil: Pumili ng backup na suspek. Mali ang boto mo pero Imposter ang backup mo? May puntos ka na parang tama ang boto mo, at ligtas ka sa Drink/Dare. Gaya pa rin ng dati ang panalo o talo sa taya mo.

cards.when: Hedge between two suspects.

notes.judge: a saved read still pays your +2.

cards.name: Reshuffle

text.en: Swap this card for a free draw now, at the normal odds, Golden included. The new card can be played from next round.
text.fil: Ipalit ito sa libreng bunot ngayon. Gaya ng dati ang tsansa sa bawat tier, pati Golden. Magagamit mo ang nabunot simula sa susunod na round.

cards.when: Swap a card that doesn't fit the roles you're getting. It can turn Golden.

cards.name: Cold Feet

text.en: After you vote, you can change your bet once, until the last ballot locks.
text.fil: Pagkaboto mo, puwede mong palitan ang taya mo nang isang beses bago ma-lock ang huling boto.

cards.when: Vote early, watch the ballot announcements, then move your bet.

notes.gambler: drop off +5/−3 when a Golden lands.

cards.name: Bluff Card

text.en: Announce a fake play under your name. Its tier is rolled like a real draw, so it can look Golden. Nothing else happens.
text.fil: Magkunwaring gumamit ng baraha. Pangalan mo ang lalabas. Gaya ng sa totoong bunot ang tsansa ng bawat tier, kaya puwedeng magmukhang Golden. Hanggang doon lang ’yon.

cards.when: Fake a play, maybe a Golden one, to draw eyes.

text.en: Lose a bet of 2 or 3? Get 1 point back.
text.fil: Natalo ang taya mong 2 o 3? May 1 puntos kang mababawi.

text.en: Earned nothing (or less) this round? Your next round's lost bet costs nothing.
text.fil: Zero o mas mababa ang puntos na nakuha mo ngayong round? Sa susunod na round, walang bawas kung matalo ang taya mo.

text.en: Get 2 points if your vote named the Imposter and no counted vote named you.
text.fil: May 2 puntos ka kung Imposter ang binoto mo at walang binilang na boto laban sa iyo.

text.en: Tied for the highest score when the session ends? You win alone.
text.fil: Tabla kayo sa unang puwesto sa dulo ng session? Ikaw lang ang panalo.

cards.name: Private Eye

text.en: Pick two other players. Secretly see whether each one is on the civilian side or the Imposter's side.
text.fil: Pumili ng dalawang ibang player. Ikaw lang ang makakakita kung sa mga sibilyan o sa Imposter kampi ang bawat isa.

cards.when: Check two suspects' sides after the clues.

notes.imposter: find your Accomplice for the pair bonus.

cards.name: Borrowed Hint

text.en: Take a secret look at the hint the Imposter got. The Imposter can't play it.
text.fil: Palihim na silipin ang hint na nakuha ng Imposter. Bawal ito sa Imposter.

cards.when: Compare the hint with the clues you've heard.

notes.decoy: see how close your word sits to the hint.

cards.name: Heavy Vote

text.en: Your counted vote counts twice (a Judge's counts three times). The Imposter can't play it.
text.fil: Kung kasama sa bilangan ang boto mo, doble ang bilang nito. Triple kung Judge ka. Bawal ito sa Imposter.

cards.when: Play when the vote is close.

cards.name: Decoy Contract

text.en: Get 3 points if the room accuses you. The Imposter can't play it. It pays even if your other gains are cancelled.
text.fil: May 3 puntos ka kung ikaw ang pagbibintangan ng grupo. Bawal ito sa Imposter. Sa iyo pa rin ang 3 kahit makansela ang iba mong nakuhang puntos ngayong round.

cards.when: Pull the accusation onto yourself.

notes.accomplice: being accused also frees your Imposter.

cards.name: Double or Nothing

text.en: Your bet pays double and costs double this round. A Gambler's top tier pays +10 and costs 6.
text.fil: Doble ang panalo at talo sa taya mo ngayong round. Sa pinakamataas na taya ng Gambler, dagdag 10 puntos kung panalo, bawas 6 kung talo.

cards.when: Play when you trust your bet's goal.

text.en: Caught as the Imposter? Pick the real word from three. If you're right, you and your Accomplice score as if you escaped.
text.fil: Nahuli kang Imposter? Piliin ang totoong salita sa tatlo. Kung tama ka, ikaw at ang Accomplice mo ay parehong makakakuha ng puntos na parang nakatakas ka.

text.en: Stay out of Drink/Dare this round? Get 4 points.
text.fil: Hindi ka napasama sa Drink/Dare ngayong round? May 4 puntos ka.

cards.name: Sealed Alibi

text.en: Secretly predict who the room will accuse. Get 3 points if you're right and your side wins the round.
text.fil: Palihim na hulaan kung sino ang pagbibintangan ng grupo. May 3 puntos ka kung tama ka at panalo ang panig mo ngayong round.

cards.when: Lock a prediction when you can read the room.

notes.imposter: predict an innocent, then steer the room onto them.

cards.name: Pocket Veto

text.en: Pick a player. Their vote isn't counted, but it still scores for them. Everyone sees 'One vote was vetoed'. A Golden Ballot can't be vetoed.
text.fil: Pumili ng player. May puntos pa rin siya gaya ng dati, pero labas sa bilangan ang boto niya. Kita ng lahat ang “May isang botong VETOED.” Ligtas ang Golden Ballot sa veto.

cards.when: Silence the vote you fear most.

notes.imposter: veto whoever you think is the Judge.

cards.name: Lawyer Up

text.en: Common and Rare cards can't touch you this round. Golden cards still can.
text.fil: Ligtas ka sa mga barahang Common at Rare ngayong round. Puwede ka pa ring tamaan ng Golden.

cards.when: Play early if you expect to be investigated.

notes.accomplice: hide your side from Private Eye.

cards.name: Objection!

text.en: Object to another player's card this round. If it was Common, it's cancelled. Anything higher is overruled. Everyone sees the verdict.
text.fil: Tutulan ang baraha ng ibang player ngayong round. Common? SUSTAINED. Kanselado ang baraha. Rare o Golden? OVERRULED ang pagtutol mo. Kita ng lahat ang hatol.

cards.when: Object to the play that hurts you, or to a Golden you think is fake.

notes.detective: a Bluff is always Common, so a fake Golden gets SUSTAINED.

cards.name: Wiretap

text.en: Pick a player. You'll see their vote the moment they lock it.
text.fil: Pumili ng player. Pagka-lock niya ng boto, makikita mo agad kung sino ang binoto niya.

cards.when: Tap the player whose vote tells you the most.

notes.judge: know where the votes are before you place your double.

cards.name: Master Key

text.en: Secretly read the real word. Only the Imposter and the Decoy can play it.
text.fil: Palihim na silipin ang totoong salita. Imposter o Decoy lang ang puwedeng gumamit nito.

cards.when: Play before your clue if you only have a hint or a Decoy word.

notes.decoy: learn the real word behind yours.

cards.name: X-Ray

text.en: Pick another player. Secretly see their exact role.
text.fil: Pumili ng ibang player. Ikaw lang ang makakakita ng eksaktong role niya.

cards.when: Check the player whose role would change your vote.

notes.accomplice: find the Detective before they find you.

cards.name: Golden Ballot

text.en: Make your vote count as four votes. Even the Imposter can vote with this card.
text.fil: Gawing apat ang bilang ng boto mo. Kahit Imposter, puwedeng bumoto gamit ito.

cards.when: Play in a close vote.

notes.imposter: the one way your vote counts.

cards.name: Crown Heist

text.en: Win your round to raise your score to the leader's score at the start of this round. The leader can't play it.
text.fil: Manalo ka sa round para mapantayan ang puntos ng nangunguna noong simula ng round. Hindi ito magagamit ng nangunguna.

cards.when: Use it when you trail by a lot.

cards.name: Midas Touch

text.en: Triple every point you earn from your role and your bet this round.
text.fil: Triple ang bawat puntos na makukuha mo sa role at taya mo ngayong round.

cards.when: Use it when you expect a big win.

cards.name: Golden Pardon

text.en: If you lose this round, turn it into a personal win and get 5 points.
text.fil: Kung matalo ka ngayong round, magiging panalo iyon para sa iyo at may 5 puntos ka.

cards.when: Play when suspicion is closing in.

notes.imposter: caught still pays +5 (your bet still settles).

cards.name: Turncoat

text.en: Secretly switch to the Imposter's side this round. Get 4 points if the Imposter escapes. Your bet rides on the escape too. Your own role doesn't score.
text.fil: Palihim kang kakampi sa Imposter ngayong round. Kung makatakas siya, may 4 na puntos ka. Sa pagtakas niya nakasalalay ang taya mo. Walang puntos mula sa sarili mong role.

cards.when: Play when you think the Imposter is winning the room.

notes.judge: your double vote now works for the Imposter.

cards.name: Spotlight

text.en: Pick a player. Everyone sees whether they're on the civilian side or the Imposter's side.
text.fil: Pumili ng player. Makikita ng lahat kung sa mga sibilyan o sa Imposter siya kampi.

cards.when: Light up your top suspect.

notes.imposter: clear an innocent to push the room elsewhere.

cards.name: Shadow

text.en: Pick a player. You also get every point they earn this round.
text.fil: Pumili ng player. Bawat puntos na makuha niya ngayong round, makukuha mo rin.

cards.when: Pick whoever you think will have the best round.

notes.gambler: shadow a calm Imposter or a big bettor.

cards.name: Robin Hood

text.en: Every leader loses 5 points. Every Underdog gets 2. With no Underdogs, you get the 5 instead. A leader can't play it.
text.fil: Bawas 5 puntos sa bawat nangunguna. Dagdag 2 sa bawat Underdog. Kung walang Underdog, sa iyo ang 5. Bawal ito sa nangunguna.

cards.when: Play when the leader is running away with it.
